title: Numb: the left hand, and both hands

blocks.text:
The left hand of Numb plays four chords one note at a time: the same four chords as countless pop songs.

**By the end** you can play bars 1–4 with both hands.

# Am, F, C, G
One chord a bar: **A minor, F, C, G**. In bar 1 the left hand plays **A E A C A E**: up the A minor chord and back. Each bar does the same with its chord. Learn the chords as triads first (fingers 5 3 1).

blocks.title: Am, F, C and G, by name
blocks.doneWhen: 10 of the 12 cards clean in one set

blocks.text:
# Ledger lines below
The left hand goes low: in bar 3 its lowest note is the **C two ledger lines below the bass staff**. Below the bottom line (G) come **F** just under it, **E** on the first ledger line, **D** under that, **C** on the second. The ledger-line cards cover both staves, above and below.

blocks.title: Ledger lines, both clefs
blocks.doneWhen: 16 of the 20 cards clean in one set

blocks.title: The left hand
blocks.about: Wait for me, left hand, bars 1–4.

blocks.title: Bars 1–4 in time

blocks.title: Bars 1–8, both hands

blocks.text:
# If this happens
- **The left hand's pattern runs ahead.** Play just the first note of each bar with the right hand's notes until the bars line up.
- **Too much at once.** Loop one bar on the score and build up.

**Until the next lesson:** both hands once a day.
